en.text: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 此后，亚扪人的王拿辖死了，他儿子接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 此後，亞捫人的王拿轄死了，他兒子接續他作王。

en.text: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣使者为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内见哈嫩，要安慰他，

zhTraditional.text: 大衛說：「我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」於是大衛差遣使者為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內見哈嫩，要安慰他，

en.text: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

zhSimplified.text: 但亚扪人的首领对哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他的臣仆来见你不是为详察窥探、倾覆这地吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 但亞捫人的首領對哈嫩說：「大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親嗎？他的臣僕來見你不是為詳察窺探、傾覆這地嗎？」

en.text: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

zhSimplified.text: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。

zhTraditional.text: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕的鬍鬚剃去一半，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。

en.text: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

zhSimplified.text: 有人将臣仆所遇的事告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，因为他们甚觉羞耻；告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」

zhTraditional.text: 有人將臣僕所遇的事告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，因為他們甚覺羞恥；告訴他們說：「可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。」

en.text: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

footnotes.text: 19:6 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds, so 1000 talents is about 30 metric tons

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，哈嫩和亚扪人就打发人拿一千他连得银子，从美索不达米亚、亚兰、玛迦、琐巴雇战车和马兵，

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，哈嫩和亞捫人就打發人拿一千他連得銀子，從美索不達米亞、亞蘭、瑪迦、瑣巴雇戰車和馬兵，

en.text: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

zhSimplified.text: 于是雇了三万二千辆战车和玛迦王并他的军兵；他们来安营在米底巴前。亚扪人也从他们的城里出来，聚集交战。

zhTraditional.text: 於是雇了三萬二千輛戰車和瑪迦王並他的軍兵；他們來安營在米底巴前。亞捫人也從他們的城裏出來，聚集交戰。

en.text: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。

en.text: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人出来在城门前摆阵，所来的诸王另在郊野摆阵。

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人出來在城門前擺陣，所來的諸王另在郊野擺陣。

en.text: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

zhSimplified.text: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵；

zhTraditional.text: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對着亞蘭人擺陣；

en.text: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

zhSimplified.text: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。

zhTraditional.text: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對着亞捫人擺陣。

en.text: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

zhSimplified.text: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。

zhTraditional.text: 約押對亞比篩說：「亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。

en.text: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和 神的城邑作大丈夫，愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和上帝的城邑作大丈夫，願耶和華憑他的意旨而行。」

en.text: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

zhSimplified.text: 于是约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。

zhTraditional.text: 於是約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。

en.text: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在约押的兄弟亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就回耶路撒冷去了。

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在約押的兄弟亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就回耶路撒冷去了。

en.text: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

zhSimplified.text: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就打发使者将大河那边的亚兰人调来，哈大利谢的将军朔法率领他们。

zhTraditional.text: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就打發使者將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來，哈大利謝的將軍朔法率領他們。

en.text: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

zhSimplified.text: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人过约旦河，来到亚兰人那里，迎着他们摆阵。大卫既摆阵攻击亚兰人，亚兰人就与他打仗。

zhTraditional.text: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人過約旦河，來到亞蘭人那裏，迎着他們擺陣。大衛既擺陣攻擊亞蘭人，亞蘭人就與他打仗。

en.text: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

zhSimplified.text: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七千辆战车的人，四万步兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。

zhTraditional.text: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑。大衛殺了亞蘭七千輛戰車的人，四萬步兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。

en.text: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

zhSimplified.text: 属哈大利谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与大卫和好，归服他。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。

zhTraditional.text: 屬哈大利謝的諸王見自己被以色列人打敗，就與大衛和好，歸服他。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
